_comment: Where the Yoyo Gyms app is allowed to navigate.
THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for two things that must never drift apart:
Capacitor's `allowNavigation` (what the WebView may open in-app) and the
entry screen's own validation (where it may send someone). If the screen
offered an address the WebView would not open, the app would hand a member
to the system browser mid-registration.
`npm run mobile:configure` regenerates www/config.js and www/qr-payload.js
from here and from shared/. Edit this file and nowhere else.
TEMPORARY ADDRESS — this is a Vercel deployment URL, not a domain.
yoyogyms.com is not registered yet. A Vercel branch URL works for testing
and is honest about what it is. What it costs, stated now rather than
discovered later: an APK built against this address KEEPS THIS ADDRESS.
Moving to a real domain means a new build and, once the app is on a store,
a new review and a new rollout. That is the trade for testing today.
REPLACE THE HOST BELOW with your own preview URL before building. It is the
address Vercel shows for the `platform` branch.
WHY NO 'enter your server address' SCREEN: Yoyo Gyms is ONE deployment
serving every gym, each a schema in the same project (D-096). The address
does not vary per gym. What varies is WHICH GYM, resolved by slug through
search or a scanned QR (D-036). Asking a gym member for a server address
would be asking them something they cannot know.
THE STAFF PANEL: the Yoyo admin panel shares this host today, so this list
cannot exclude it by hostname. What protects it is that every staff route
requires a permission no gym owner holds (D-128), and the entry screen never
links there. Serving the panel from its own hostname is the intended fix.
